description: Compare email marketing tools for ecommerce workflows such as abandoned-cart reminders, product campaigns, audience segmentation, and lifecycle messaging. This page does not claim firsthand testing of live stores; current prices, feature limits, and revenue impact must be verified with each vendor and against your own store data.
author: Emily Nakamura

faqs.question: What is the best email marketing tool for Shopify stores?
faqs.answer: Klaviyo is the best for Shopify stores. It has the deepest integration, predictive analytics, and pre-built flows for abandoned carts, winbacks, and product recommendations. It's worth the investment for stores doing +/month.

faqs.question: Can I use email marketing for free?
faqs.answer: Yes, Omnisend offers 500 free emails/month with abandoned cart flows. Mailchimp offers free for 500 contacts but limits ecommerce features. Brevo offers 300 free emails/day. For serious ecommerce, paid plans (-50/mo) are worth it.

faqs.question: How do abandoned cart emails work?
faqs.answer: Abandoned cart emails trigger when a customer adds items to their cart but doesn't complete checkout. The tool automatically sends 2-3 follow-up emails with the cart contents, typically recovering 5-15% of lost sales.

faqs.question: How much should I spend on email marketing?
faqs.answer: For stores under /month revenue, -50/month covers most needs. For stores doing -500K/month, budget -500/month. The ROI on email marketing is typically 30-40x the cost.

faqs.question: Which tool has the best deliverability?
faqs.answer: Klaviyo, ActiveCampaign, and Drip consistently achieve 95%+ inbox rates. Mailchimp's deliverability has declined in recent years. All tools improve deliverability with proper list hygiene and authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
